## Chapter Fifteen

Taking Stock



It took nearly an hour to collect the children and dress them. Two other women appeared once Marta had rung a bell in the large foyer of the building and scrambled as soon as the situation was explained to them.

The large truck had descended forty minutes later and they had taken the next twenty minutes to load everyone on. Rollie and Lucas stayed behind as the vehicle lifted off to parts unknown. “Don’t worry the driver knows where to take them, he is the only one who does for security reasons.” He finished, untying the satchel from his waist. “Help me drag these bodies inside, we still have work to do .” he prodded his friend. Lucas walked over to the carnage they had left earlier “What do you mean work?” he asked. As the two hefted the first body and carried it into the factory.

“We need to buy them a little time so we are going to blow up the factory, hopefully they will think that during the mission the group screwed up and got themselves blown up, it won’t stick for long but maybe long enough for the kids trail to go cold” he answered in between grunts as they heaved the body into the cold factory floor and then proceeded to go out and get the other three. Once all six bodies were piled in the entrance. Rollie told Lucas to stay put and he quickly disappeared deep into the bowels of the old building.

When he returned an hour later, he grabbed his friends shoulder and practically pushed him out of the building. “We need to get back to the car he said, moving back into the woods with Lucas in tow. Once they had gotten two or three hundred steps, Lucas had lost count after one fifty when a branch had slammed into his midsection once Rollie had let it go and knocked the wind out of him. Once Lucas had recovered from doubling over his friend stood there staring at him curiously “You okay” he asked and Lucas nodded. “Just easy with the branches there bud” he wheezed and they continued to walk.

At two or three hundred steps Rollie pulled out a small black box. “Get behind a big tree” he said and began to walk towards one. Lucas did the same, once he was satisfied they both had cover Rollie hit the little button on the box . As soon as it was pressed it was like Thunder rolled right over the two of them followed by clouds of dust and debris.

Lucas tried to look back, to see what was left of the building but he couldn’t see anything before ten feet in front of him. After a few minutes he gave up trying and the two moved back to the car. By the time they arrived dawn was breaking over West Virginia.

Once they had settled into the car Rollie took a familiar black box out of the glove compartment. Rollie opened it and removed his watch , with a quick motion of his fingers the screen floated above the watch face. Looking at it backwards Lucas could see him open a text app and type one word. It took him a second to figure it out as it was in reverse to him, but the word was booyah. Rollie shut down the interface and put the watch back in the box and the box back in the glove compartment.

They car ascended into the sky and quickly rejoined the skyway headed back to DC.

The two were silent for the entire trip back, they landed as late day broke over DC, rush hour had just started, and the skyway traffic was getting heavy as the car descended back to the parking deck and landed. Lucas helped his friend cover the car. Picking up a bag with the suits in it. Rollie had assured him he had carried them through the checkpoint in this very same bag numerous times they began walking back towards the Poverty Bloc.

They passed back through the checkpoint with no issue and were soon walking down the catwalk stairs onto the dancefloor of Studio DC to find Job and Sally at the bar waiting for them. Both had fresh drinks in front of them. Sally turned and waved both the young men over, as he approached Lucas spied the crooked wig and bloodshot eyes neither had slept last night and looked quite like he felt. “How did it go?” Job asked gruffly turning to Lucas. The young man hung his head, trying to hide his conflicted thoughts as he gathered his thoughts. “We got the kids out, six soldiers terminated, then we moved them into the building and using their own explosives, detonated it. It should buy us some time but not a lot. The car needs to disappear, once they realize that their people failed, they will go back looking for leads and the only one is your car” he said looking at Sally. He winced and shook his head. “I liked that car, but it is clean, it leads back to a banker in New York, but I’ll have Rollie get rid of it” he started turning back to his drink, but not touching it. Lucas thought neither of them had actually imbibed much of the liquid in front of them, instead opting to use it as a distraction from their own thoughts.

Job ran his fingers over the deep gouges in the warn bar top looking off into the distance, lost in his thoughts. Lucas remained silent, they had problems, big problems and no leads as to where to look. “There is a traitor in your midst” the words kept coming back to haunt him. The now deceased woman had been silenced to ensure that the identity of their very own mole was never revealed. And now that mole, that traitor had begun disassembling their network, that wasn’t what bothered Lucas, it had been the children, they were going to kill the children and for that. Lucas would hunt down this traitor and end his life. “The children have been moved temporarily, only two people know the new safehouse. But we have bigger problems, two more were hit last night” Job finally stated without raising his eyes from the glass in front of him. Lucas jolted from his thoughts of vengeance, turning to his friend. “Which ones?” he asked in a whisper not wanting to hear it. Sally got up and turned to face the two young men. “Lewes Delaware and Cape May New Jersey, both part of our route north to Canada, fortunately Roger and Brenda McCallan were out shopping. when the Vipers hit and no one was killed, one of our agents are on their way here along with Video from the Cape May incident. They had a closed-circuit system and it captured the event. The entire family was killed along with another three we were transporting out of the country” He finished hanging his head.

Job stood and began pacing along the bar. “Whoever is informing the government isn’t handing them all the information at once, in fact I think it’s more of a trickle” he said pulling a large folded piece of paper from within his jacket. He carefully laid out the old yellowing paper on the bar, Lucas could see colors, lines and words in small print. “This is a map of the old United States” he said answering the unasked question. “If you look closely you can see the red marks are our safe houses, these are ones we use to hide and transport people out of the country or into the country when we need to” he stated. Again, gently smoothing out the old man.

Lucas looked closely at the map, seeing the line of scattered red dots running up and down the eastern seaboard and then out towards the west as far as Idaho. “This person is not only trying to eliminate us but doing so in a way that systematically shuts down our operations. This person is someone who knows too many intimate details about how we are setup and how we are run” Job finished no emotion in his voice, as his haunted eyes roved over the old-world man.

“What do you mean?” Lucas asked concentrating on the paper and trying to decipher anything he could from the red circles scattered over it. Job blew out a breath. “Well you know of the Orphanage, and now the two here” Job pointed to Delaware and then at the southernmost point in New Jersey. “These aren’t just safe houses, they are part of a route, they are intake centers and when we are in the midst of moving people are the places where you will find the most refugees, like the orphanage. When we take someone in, they come into a safehouse close to where we make contact, then we move them around.”

He pointed at the New Jersey dot “This one allows us to move up from Maryland/DC and Virginia towards Northern New York, but also it services West Virginia and Tennessee so it’s kind of like a choke point, at any given time there will always be more targets in Cape May, then in one of the more norther safe houses in New Jersey. So, whoever is giving them the locations to hit, is doing so in a deliberate manner, allowing only a few at a time and in such a way to ensure they will cripple our operations” he finished.

“Please tell me we know who it is?” Lucas asked the cold rage returning as he thought of the children and what had almost happened. What kind of person could do that to kids, deliberately do that? He wondered. Job and Sally shared a meaningful look both Lucas and Rolle caught the shared moment. “What, what aren’t you saying” Rolle asked, stepping into the conversation for the first time.

At first no one spoke, and the room was as silent as a grave yard. Both older men trying to formulate how to say their next statement. It was Sally who finally broke the silence.

“Of the people who would have this level of intimate knowledge of not only the locations but also the infrastructure and how we move people, and knowledge of the orphanage which is one of our closest guarded secrets, there are only three people with that knowledge and two of them are in this room” he said. Lucas looked between the two older men “Who is the third?” he asked, suddenly not wanting him to answer that question, not wanting to hear the name that somewhere in his mind he suspected, felt shame for suspecting and Job brought his fear into the light “You were in prison with him”.

Rolle stood their eyes wide and shaking his head. “No way man, not Dyson, he would never give us up, had never given us up, what would have changed, what could have possibly made him do something like that?” he asked.

Job seemed to deflate under the verbal assault. “We don’t know, we are not absolutely sure its him, but there aren’t a whole lot of suspects. It is possible they learned about it from other means or some kind of intercept or its also possible they have been investigating us and just now deciding to take apart our organization” he said. Weak Lucas thought bitterly, every one of those theories were weak.

Before the argument could continue Chow came down the stairs followed by a dirty and disheveled woman of about thirty, her eyes darted around the room fearfully as if at any moment someone would come out and kill her. “Roberta, I’m so glad your safe dear” Sally said rushing over to the plump woman and throwing his arms around her in comfort. The woman seemed to collapse as if all the energy she had, had kept her standing and had finally run out. Rolle was there too, grabbing her up and carrying her over to the bar, where he gently sat her on a stool and moved around the large bar to make the woman a drink. Lucas stood there unmoving as the others settled the poor woman. Lucas’s eyes moved over her; her condition told her story.

The dirty and tattered brown work coat with dirt and mud stains over the back, told Lucas she had spent time laying on the ground, on her back, her tattered jeans and mud covered boots spoke to rushing through the woods and along the bank near a body of water , her dirty red hair still had sticks and leaves in it. She had run through the woods, had run a long way from the looks of it he thought. Once she had calmed down Roberta began to tell her story in a wavering voice that the others had to move in close to hear. The reedy tones barely audible over the bar area.

“Rog and Brenda had gone out; I was at the shop alone feeding six new arrivals that had come in that day. Everyone was settled in and had been fed. I was about to wash the dishes when I realized that I had left the light on out in the storage shed where we keep the extra blankets and supplies” She started, her eyes darting among the small group gathered there. “I went out to the shed, to turn out the light. While I was there, I spent a few minutes cleaning up, that’s when I heard the first shot” Roberta paused for a moment, cleaning some of the branches out of her hair. Sally put his hand on her shoulder and lightly squeezed, encouraging her to continue. Nodding she went on. “It took two more before I was certain what it was. So, I shut the light off and opened the trap door, where we keep the server for the video recording as well as extra supplies and cash” she said. “I stayed down there for half the night until I was sure they were gone, when I went back into the house, I found the bodies and the explosives set to go off, I rushed out of the house , stopping long enough to grab the drive out of the security system” she finished tears openly flowing down her cheeks as she laid her head on the bar.

She reached into one of the pockets of the torn and dirty work coat and produced a small metal box. Sally gently took it from her, nodding to Rolle who took it with something like reverence and disappeared into the back room. “Chow, can you get her some food and clean clothes, also show her where she can get cleaned up” Sally said to her guard. Chow nodded and with a gentleness that surprised Lucas he guided her to the other side of the dancefloor and through another door. As the door closed Lucas whirled on Sally and Job “How could you think its Dyson, he started this, this is his life” he hissed. Both older men looked down as if in guilt. “Dyson may have started this, but he does not lead the initiative” Job said quietly and then looked up to lock eyes with the young man, his friend. Sally put a hand on Jobs arm and stood, walking over to Lucas. “What you are about to hear isn’t something we usually tell people, and normally, you being Dyson’s protégé and his insistence that you be brought in despite not telling us why, we would suspect you as a plant. But you had ample options to not only kill us , but to railroad the orphanage rescue, since you did not, we are going to trust you, we have to trust you. This is going to get worse before it gets better” Sally sighed, keeping eye contact with the younger man. “One Dyson founded this , he began to reach out and make contacts, some of them powerful, he realized that if we were led by one person, the death of that person would send the network into chaos, and while Dyson was the poster boy for our movement, the actual leadership is kept secret, even we don’t really know who they are. We get orders, we follow the orders. We know it’s a group of people, people that Dyson brought in, people that are powerful and want to see the resurrection of the old United States.” He finished Lucas sat heavily on a bar stool. He could understand why they would have kept this to themselves, but still a small ping of anger at not being trusted still bloomed in his chest, but he swallowed it for now.

Before he could respond V emerged resplendent in a maroon bathrobe from the back room. The first think that Lucas noticed was the pained look on her face. “You guys need to see this” she said and motioned for them to join her through the door. The group gathered and walked into the back room where a small metal box had been laid on the food prep table. Floating above it appeared to be a view of the inside of a house. The wood furniture, pictures and simple décor gave it the air of a farmhouse, someplace where the people weren’t rich, but were very happy. It was the kind of place you would want to spend Christmas at. Victoria stood their shoulders stooped, Lucas didn’t like the look of this, she wouldn’t make eye contact with anyone. Well this isn’t good he thought, stepping up to the holo projector as everyone gathered around. “Here is the tape of Cape May, I will tell you know you are not going to like what you see” she stated but gave no details. Everyone gathered around and with a wave of her hand the show began. The group watched as Roberta passed, walking out the door “This must be where she goes out to check the light in the shed” Sally said. No one else spoke, they concentrated on the empty room.

It was only a few moments later when four gunmen clad in black tactical gear rushed through the room. “Do we have another angle on this?” Lucas asked frustrated. Victoria shook her head “Just watch” she said but the tone in her voice said he really didn’t want to see what was about to happen. They continued to watch and five minutes later they were rewarded as six people three men two women and a six-year-old child were lined up and made to kneel in the living room. The camera catching it all as they stood around with the six kneeling. Lucas could see in high detail the crying and begging , there was no sound but the expressions on their face, the fear and begging were evident, one of the women tried to comfort the child and a soldier hit her in the back of the head with the butt of his rifle. The entire group gathered around the projector winced in unison. Lucas watched, wondering what they were waiting for, hoping they would detain and transport them, begging the video to not end how he thought it might and then his stomach dropped as a new person walked into the room.

This one in a simple pair of jeans and a black T-Shirt. He gave orders and one of the guards went further into the house, it was clear this was the man in charge. His head was down, he was looking at his prisoners. But the walk and the stance looked all too familiar and then in one quick motion the man produced a gun and shot each of the detained prisoners. He saved the child for last seeming to revel in the screams Lucas could imagine that young girl making and then he shot her.

The six bodies now laying on the floor as blood began to pool over the floor. Then the man looked at the camera and everyone gasped. “No fucking way” Lucas whispered this was not possible “this must be a trick” he continued as everyone else stood there stock still, not speaking as Dyson stared back at them from the holo viewer smoking gun still in his hand.

No one spoke as the video turned off, they just stood there. “No fucking way” Lucas said again. Victoria stood there hugging herself looking at the ground Lucas could see the track lines of tears going down her cheeks. “Well that answers that question” Sally said but his voice was steeped with sadness as he turned and headed back out to the club’s dancefloor. Everyone followed without protest, just shocked, this was a man they trusted, looked up to and to some of them Lucas thought considered him like a father. The group gathered at the bar and it was Job who finally broke the silence. We need to enact final protocols; we have been infiltrated and nothing we have is safe. Dyson knows every intimate detail about us and about where our houses, finances and personnel are.

He turned to Sally leveling a hard gaze at the gently man. “I need your codes” he said startling the other man “What?” he asked as if he had not heard him correctly. “I need your codes” he said again. “We need to enact the final protocol; we need scorched earth” he finally said. Sally nodded a defeated look on his face. “I will get them; we need to start bringing people in and closing houses” he said without emotion in his voice the man just sounded tired and defeated.

Job nodded “Lucas and Rolle can head that up while we get the rest taken care of, we have seventy-two hours to get things in order before we go dark” Job stated to the group. Rolle came up behind Lucas and he turned to his friend. Seeing the face that had so many times held a smile the contrast of his white teeth and dark skin making the expression stand out. “What codes?” he asked, and Rolle nodded at the two of them. “They may answer higher-ups but the funds that run our entire operation are handled by two people, it was Dyson and Sally, but when Dyson went away, he passed it to Job. In order to get access and move the funds two bank codes are needed” he explained quietly. Rolle leaned in still looking at Sally and Job as they argued quietly. “Did you ever figure out what Dyson wanted from you, why he brought you in?” he asked his friend. Lucas shook his head “I don’t know but whatever it was, I don’t think he needs it now” Lucas finished an edge of bitterness in his voice.

Victoria came out of the back room and was leaning against the wall, watching Sally and Job looking more like she was lost in thought then actually paying attention. Lucas went over to her; he could see the puffy cheeks and red eyes and knew this had hit her just as hard as it had him. Without a word he gently threw his arms around her and squeezed lightly and reassuringly. Victoria buried her head in his chest, and he could feel the hitching of her body as another set of crying passed through her. “He was like a father to me” she said her muffled voice barley recognizable. Lucas nodded dropping his head so only she could hear.

“I know what we saw, and he was like a father to me as well, that’s why I know that can’t be him. But I need you to dig into that file. Doesn’t it seem odd that there was only one camera in the house yet they brought the prisoners directly in front of it so we would see the execution and who did it?” he asked. Lucas looked around to ensure he wasn’t getting any unwanted attention and Victoria stopped crying, she raised her head and those sea blue eyes locked on his one good one. “Do you think it was a show?” she asked, and he nodded. “Don’t you, think about it?” he said prodding her to walk through the logic he had already deduced. Her eyes darted back and forth as her mind, her beautiful intelligent analytical mind played through what she had seen, and then they went wide. “Just when we were wondering who the traitor was…” she began “We see a video that puts the debate to rest” he finished.

Victoria pulled away, still looking around and Lucas stopped her before she could retreat into the back “For now, keep this between us” he said again looking around to ensure they weren’t being overheard. She nodded and disappeared into the kitchen.

Sally motioned to Rolle and him to join him. Still looking defeated he pulled an envelope out of the pocket of the kimono he wore, this one purple with flowers, Lucas thought it a little too cheery for the situation but kept that to himself. “These are the list of safehouses and who runs them, you two will go to these personally and help them shut down, protect them in case of attack and tell them to return here, we are gathering everyone so we can move them out. Everything has been compromised, no one is safe, so be careful out there and protect our people” he said emotion and urgency thick in his words. Both nodded and then retreated to get ready to move out.

Before they could leave the dance floor area Chow appeared carrying two duffel bags “Sally told me to collect your things from Job’s, he also had me add a few items you might need” he said with that same dead pan expression, he handed the bags to them and then returned to Sally’s side as if to await his next set of orders.

The two men retreated into the kitchen, Victoria and the holo projector were no longer present. Lucas opened his bag pulling out the suit and helmet as well as his knife set. He went to put the bag on the floor and realized from the weight there was more in there. He grabbed the edges of the bag and opened it to peer inside. Lucas cocked his head and then reached in pulling out two blades that were about three feet long each and looked more like swords then knifes. They also came with a harness that would allow them to be fitted to his back, complimenting the knife harness instead of blocking it from the look of the design. However instead of the blades being pulled from the top of his shoulders they would also be pulled from the bottom of his back, basically hanging upside down with the handles pointed at the floor. Lucas felt the blades they were some sort of cross between a metal and polymer not the same material as his daggers but stronger and a bit heavier.

He looked over to Rolle to ask about the swords, but his eyebrow rose as he saw his friend holding what looked like two small crossbows. Rolle too looked confused. Pointing one at the wall he aimed expertly with the little weapon and pulled the trigger. The high-tension metal wire sprung forward sending the razor-sharp metal tipped polymer bolt halfway into the wall. Rolle looked down at it appreciatively and nodded “This is cool” he said and then looked up at his friend. “What the hell is that?” Lucas said the swords forgotten for a moment. “They are called micro bolt throwers, we have been working on them for a while, I have used the bigger ones, about half the size of a crossbow, but these are amazing and powerful” he finished still looking at the weapon more like a man might appreciate a good looking woman.

“You guys want to be alone?” Lucas asked his friend semi-sarcastically and they both laughed. Sally entered the room and looked over his boys “you guys look bad ass” he said and smiled, though Lucas could see the pain and betrayal behind that smile, he was putting on a show for them and he appreciated it. “Okay, we are ready to roll” he said looking over the list, it was going to be a lot of traveling over the next couple of days he thought looking at the list of states. Sally handed them both sets of keys “I had chow put your rides out front” he said this time the smile was genuine. Confused, knowing that cars were not allowed in the poverty bloc, he followed Rolle upstairs and out into the courtyard. Once they reached the front of the large yard, they both stopped in their tracks and in unison whispered “No fucking way” with the reverence of a priest seeing god.

Sitting there in the yard were two black new model Samurai hoverbikes, these things looked like they were speeding when standing still. The bottom of the bike held gravimetric pads, and there were two that faced outward from the bike as well, allowing it to stay upright. The cowling covering the handlebars was low and looked more like a predatorial beak then the front of a bike.

They mounted the bikes and activated the engines, listening to the purr of the powerful electric motors as they whined to life, the stabilization system lifting the bike an inch off the ground and the side stabilizers ensuring they were upright. Rolle leaned over to him “GPS and wireless are removed so we are going to have to find these places the old-fashioned way” he said pulling out a large paper map and smiling at his friend. “Just follow me, I have done this before” Rolle finished and Lucas leaned in glancing at the old and yellowing paper “Weren’t those meant to follow roads, like on the ground?” he asked, and Rolle just shrugged. “It’s an interpretive art, but I’m sure I’ll find the places” and he smiled that wide infectious grin again that said “what could possibly go wrong.

The two shot up towards the skyway at breakneck speed, quickly merging into traffic the two bikes disappeared into the flow of Vehicles.
